description: This file defines the PlaywrightPipeServer class, which manages a server for inter-process communication via named pipes or sockets, handling connections, and initializing browser modes.

classes.name: PlaywrightPipeServer
classes.description: Manages server-side pipe connections for Playwright, including listening, connection handling, and shutdown.

methods.name: constructor
methods.description: Initializes the server with a Browser instance and sets up disconnection handling.

methods.name: listen
methods.description: Starts listening on a specified pipe name, accepting incoming connections.

methods.name: _initPreLaunchedBrowserMode
methods.description: Configures the server to operate in pre-launched browser mode.

methods.name: close
methods.description: Closes the server and all active connections.
